## Self-review / gap analysis (closing)

- **`public` is evidenced, never defaulted** — the only path to
  `public` is a recorded `raw-ok` lane plus a `clear`/`none-known`
  Part VIII class; unknown, absent, restricted, unresolved and
  insufficiently evidenced sources derive `sealed` at write and
  tighten at read. The read path serves the *more restrictive* of
  recorded and derived — never an upgrade.
- **Recorded `unknown` ≠ absent** — the parser distinguishes the
  recorded fail-closed verdict (with its thin evidence + authority)
  from an undeclared block (interim basis, `lane == ""`); the
  mirror writes the former, never fabricates the latter.
- **Least-privilege boundary** — `sig_export` reads the explicit-
  column view; `sig_read_public` joins only the publishable-fields
  `_current` projection for the served-tier floor (named on the
  exact allow-list); the append-only base table is write-path only.
- **Sensitive surface is structurally absent** — registry notes,
  contact, auth model/access method, reviewer identity beyond
  role, classified terms text and P8-1 payloads are never view
  columns; the artifact, not the view, is the publication
  boundary.
- **Known limits recorded** — the artifacts ride the next
  republish under that row's authority (out of scope: the
  `/sources/` pages P36.40/44, the verdict P37.36, the terms page
  P35.40). A source with no matrix row records `unknown` +
  `review_needed`, honest thin evidence — never a guessed lane.
